messages:
Priya: Hey team — Acme Corp asks for a private POC. They want to validate node-level preflight before we ship the installer. Key asks: GPU driver, kernel modules, k8s version, container runtime, NTP, certs, outbound KMS egress. Who can own a checklist?
Jon: I can. Quick q: will this be air-gapped?
Priya: partially air-gapped — control plane in their VPC, nodes isolated but allowed outbound to S3 and KMS through proxy.
Jon: OK. We'll need these checks on each node: 1) nvidia-smi present + CUDA driver >= 12.1; 2) lsmod shows nvidia, nvidia_uvm; 3) kernel driver version matches driver; 4) containerd or docker with nvidia runtime; 5) kubelet v1.26-1.28; 6) iptables/nftables rules allow pod egress to control plane; 7) NTP sync; 8) certs/key access for installer; 9) required ports 22, 2379-2380, 10250, 30000-32767 etc.
Anika: add kernel headers present for DKMS modules and gcc toolchain for building any module; check /usr/src. Also check SELinux/AppArmor mode.
Carlos: I'm from Acme — we can run commands, send outputs. Which commands?
Jon: Run and paste outputs:

- nvidia-smi -L
- nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv
- lsmod | egrep 'nvidia|nvidia_uvm|nvidia_drm'
- modinfo nvidia | head
- uname -r && (rpm -q --whatprovides kernel-devel || apt-cache policy linux-headers-$(uname -r))
- crictl ps -a || docker ps -a
- kubectl version --short
- timedatectl status
- cat /etc/hosts && ip route show
- curl -sS https://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ (if cloud)

Jon: If nodes are airgapped, we need offline drivers and container runtime images + certificate bundle.
Priya: Pricing note for dedicated pool — if nodes are gated behind strict network restrictions there will be an additional ops hour estimate. I'll flag in the quote.
Anika: On the KMS bit: installer needs egress to the customer's KMS endpoint (TLS 443). If they use HSM behind private link, we may need VPN or a bastion.
Carlos: For NTP we use chrony. Is that acceptable?
Jon: Yes but ensure drift < 500ms and systemd-timesyncd disabled to avoid conflict.
InfraBot: Preflight checklist created: https://intranet.redwood/devices/preflight-template (auto) :white_check_mark:
Priya: Carlos — please run these and upload outputs to the secure link. I'll coordinate with field eng to schedule a remote session next Tue.
Carlos: Will do, thanks.
Jon: Also confirm NVIDIA driver installer mode (runfile vs package) — runfile requires stopping display manager.
Anika: Reminder: verify swap is disabled or kubelet has swap disabled flag.
Carlos: Uploaded logs to the secure link and pinged you all.
Jon: Got them. Early look — driver is 510.x, we need >= 525 for CUDA12.1. We'll need a driver update step in the preflight.
Priya: Noted — I'll update POC scope and pricing.
Carlos: Any rollback plan for driver upgrade?
Jon: We document steps and snapshot VMs where possible; for baremetal we recommend rescue boot media and creating node images. We'll schedule maintenance window.
Priya: Great — thanks everyone. I'll create the formal preflight doc and share. :rocket:
